<a id="activitynet-qa"></a>

## ActivityNet-QA

- **Role:** adjacent
- **Task:** Open-ended video question answering
- **Domain:** ActivityNet activity videos
- **Videos:** 5800
- **Duration:** Mean 180 seconds (paper); total/range not independently verified
- **Annotations:** 58000 human question-answer pairs
- **Annotators:** 10 QA pairs/video; unique annotator count not reported
- **Granularity:** Video-question-answer triplets
- **Summary format:** Not applicable: no reference summaries
- **Split:** 3200 train / 1800 validation / 800 test
- **Metrics:** Answer accuracy; WUPS@0.0; WUPS@0.9
- **License:** Not reported
- **Availability:** Official repository supplies QA annotations/evaluation; obtain ActivityNet media separately
- **Official url:** [official url](https://github.com/MILVLG/activitynet-qa)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://github.com/activitynet/ActivityNet/tree/master/Crawler)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://github.com/MILVLG/activitynet-qa)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** Follow question/answer split identifiers and source-video mapping
- **Features:** Original work extracts VGG-16 fc7 and C3D fc7; repository tensor release not independently verified
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** Shared ActivityNet parent corpus can overlap other benchmark training; QA labels are human supervision
- **Limitations:** No keyshot, importance or summary-duration labels; auxiliary understanding dataset only
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://github.com/MILVLG/activitynet-qa) · [source 2](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/4946)

<a id="cosum"></a>

## CoSum / Co-Sum

- **Role:** core
- **Task:** Collection-aware query-adaptive video co-summarization
- **Domain:** 10 topical groups of web videos
- **Videos:** 51
- **Duration:** 147 minutes 40 seconds total (official README)
- **Annotations:** Query-related selected shots; reference pools majority selections
- **Annotators:** 3 judges
- **Granularity:** Presegmented shots
- **Summary format:** Ranked/selected shots
- **Split:** No canonical train/test split reported
- **Metrics:** mAP@5 shots; mAP@15 shots
- **License:** Not reported
- **Availability:** Official repository has URLs, preprocessed shot indices and annotations; raw videos not durably hosted
- **Official url:** [official url](https://github.com/l2ior/cosum)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://github.com/l2ior/cosum)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://github.com/l2ior/cosum/tree/master/annotation)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** Use supplied shot indices and declared subdivision of long shots
- **Features:** Paper descriptors: CENTRIST, Dense-SIFT, HSV moments; ready-made tensors not independently verified
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** Query-group and cross-video co-occurrence exposure is part of the method; do not call it a single-video setting
- **Limitations:** 51 instances does not guarantee 51 distinct currently retrievable files; mAP is not temporal F1
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://github.com/l2ior/cosum) · [source 2](https://people.csail.mit.edu/yalesong/publications/ChuSJ2015CVPR.pdf)

## Ego4D

- **Role:** adjacent
- **Task:** Egocentric perception, episodic memory and other benchmark tasks
- **Domain:** Daily-life first-person video across locations and participants
- **Videos:** Not reported here: version-specific manifest required
- **Duration:** Official landing page: 3670 hours; documentation/repository use other version-dependent rounded totals
- **Annotations:** Narrations and task-specific perception annotations; no single native generic-summary reference layer
- **Annotators:** Task-dependent; not one common summary-annotator count
- **Granularity:** Task-dependent clips, narrations, moments and trajectories
- **Summary format:** Not applicable to base dataset
- **Split:** Version- and benchmark-specific
- **Metrics:** Task-specific retrieval, localization, forecasting and perception metrics
- **License:** Ego4D license agreement and approval required; licensed data/annotation access
- **Availability:** Credential-gated download via official CLI; no download attempted
- **Official url:** [official url](https://ego4d-data.org/)

- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://ego4d-data.org/docs/start-here/)

- **Preprocessing:** Pin release version, benchmark, video_uid and selected modality/subset
- **Features:** Official CLI supports a features package; feature model and release must be checked per manifest
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** Participant/video overlap and derived dataset overlap require explicit checks; narratives are annotation supervision

<a id="knowvis"></a>

## KnowVis

- **Role:** core
- **Task:** Lecture video to pedagogical visual-summary generation
- **Domain:** 125 open educational lectures across ten academic disciplines
- **Videos:** 125 source videos producing 1,079 knowledge-unit summary records
- **Duration:** Exact aggregate and range not tabulated; paper Figure 2 plots source videos at roughly 5–40 minutes, while released source_video_length units are undocumented
- **Annotations:** Machine-generated records with concept, rendered image, concept-subgraph triples, transcript, slide-path sequence and source-video metadata; not human gold summaries
- **Annotators:** No human dataset annotators reported; GPT-5.4/Claude judges and the ten-person user study evaluate outputs rather than author reference annotations
- **Granularity:** Concept and knowledge-unit level
- **Summary format:** Generated pedagogical image/visual narrative paired with a knowledge subgraph, transcript and slides
- **Split:** One Hugging Face knowledge_units split with 1,079 records; no train/validation/test partition
- **Metrics:** 1–5 LLM-judged accuracy; clarity; information density; mental effort; human learning effectiveness; retention; transfer
- **License:** Unresolved: paper Appendix F says the dataset will be CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, but the pinned live dataset card has no license field and the repository has no LICENSE; source lectures mix CC BY, CC BY-NC-SA and Standard YouTube terms
- **Availability:** Public ungated pinned release; provider reports 803,323,547 bytes download size and 795,842,288.247 bytes dataset size. Bodies were not downloaded.
- **Official url:** [official url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yixu-cityu/KnowVis/tree/ba4208a250bc60b03d0b4ea48f1c2dc70c2d77cc)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yixu-cityu/KnowVis/tree/ba4208a250bc60b03d0b4ea48f1c2dc70c2d77cc)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yixu-cityu/KnowVis/tree/ba4208a250bc60b03d0b4ea48f1c2dc70c2d77cc)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** Transcript/slide extraction; Gemini-3-Flash concept graph; top-10% important and challenging seed concepts; LabelSpreading with clamping factor alpha=0.9 and node-to-seed inclusion threshold 0.8; storyboard; Gemini-3.1-Flash-Image render and one verification pass
- **Features:** Structured text, graph, image and slide-path records; no fixed pretrained tensor schema
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** No held-out split; source/provider pretraining overlap is unknown; the released summaries are outputs of the evaluated proprietary pipeline; underlying lecture rights vary
- **Limitations:** No executable generation code, no split, proprietary model drift, generated artifacts rather than human references, ambiguous live-release license and a ten-person human study
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-19
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.03742v2) · [source 2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yixu-cityu/KnowVis/tree/ba4208a250bc60b03d0b4ea48f1c2dc70c2d77cc) · [source 3](https://github.com/yixu-cityu/KnowVis/tree/da14209fd4a7483474fad4fefdde8f0920290976)

<a id="mosu"></a>

## MoSu (Most Replayed Multimodal Video Summarization)

- **Task:** Multimodal importance prediction and extractive summarization using behavioral targets
- **Domain:** YouTube8M-derived, 3406 categories grouped into 10 topics
- **Duration:** 3983.7 hours; mean 272.25 seconds; range 120–501 seconds
- **Annotations:** YouTube Most Replayed statistics: 100 initial bins, bias-corrected and aligned to frames; derived gt_score and gt_summary
- **Annotators:** Aggregated viewer behavior, not explicit summary annotations; inclusion threshold is over 50000 views, not a verified distinct-annotator count
- **Granularity:** Replay curve aligned to 1-second feature positions; stored change points
- **Summary format:** Importance curve and derived binary summary
- **Split:** Topic-stratified: 42152 train / 5263 validation / 5263 test
- **License:** Official dataset card: CC-BY-4.0; source YouTube media rights remain separate; repository code MIT
- **Availability:** Official metadata, ground truth, feature HDF5 and splits advertised; no binary archives downloaded in this run
- **Official url:** [official url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/hminjeong/TripleSumm-MoSu)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/hminjeong/TripleSumm-MoSu/tree/main)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/hminjeong/TripleSumm-MoSu/tree/main)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** English or YouTube-translated transcripts and audio required; aligned visual, text and audio features at 1-second intervals
- **Features:** Official CLIP ViT-L/14, RoBERTa-base and AST HDF5; each video matrix N x 768; card advertises about 40 GB per modality and 136 GB total
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** YouTube8M-derived source overlap with other web corpora requires source-ID deduplication; replay statistics and pretrained encoders introduce separate provenance issues
- **Limitations:** Replays measure engagement rather than independently judged summary completeness; raw media retrieved by source IDs may disappear; derived binary targets depend on decoding
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Role:** core
- **Videos:** 52678
- **Metrics:** Kendall tau; Spearman rho; mAP50 and mAP15 under Mr. HiSum 5-second segment protocol
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.01169v1) · [source 2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/hminjeong/TripleSumm-MoSu) · [source 3](https://github.com/smkim37/TripleSumm)

<a id="multi-vidsum"></a>

## Multi-VidSum

- **Role:** core
- **Task:** Ordered keyframe-caption pair generation from video
- **Domain:** ActivityNet Captions open-domain videos
- **Videos:** 12009
- **Duration:** Inherits ActivityNet Captions video durations; aggregate duration not independently tabulated in the inspected paper
- **Annotations:** Crowdsourced candidate keyframes aligned to dense captions; paper Table 1 reports 14.72 candidate keyframes per caption, 4.8 captions per video and 13.20 words per sentence
- **Annotators:** Crowd workers select candidate frames; separate native-English-speaker annotators recruited through a data company re-caption the evaluation subset. Exact annotator count per item is not restated here.
- **Granularity:** Ordered event caption with one of multiple valid frame candidates
- **Summary format:** A predefined number of ordered keyframe-caption pairs
- **Split:** 7,727 videos from ActivityNet training; 439 re-captioned evaluation videos sampled from the original 4,282-video validation split. No ordinary independent validation split is stated; experiment validation subsets are sampled internally.
- **Metrics:** AKM exact; AKM cosine; BLEURT; METEOR
- **License:** Pinned Hugging Face dataset card declares Apache-2.0 for the released archive; code/evaluator repositories have no LICENSE at inspected commits, and ActivityNet media rights remain separate
- **Availability:** Official Hugging Face release lists a 33,838,742,254-byte download.tar.gz LFS object; only repository metadata and the LFS pointer were inspected, not the archive body, videos or models
- **Official url:** [official url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tohoku-nlp/multi-vidsum/tree/ca03b147ddb4959229b510bde8eacc55933088af)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tohoku-nlp/multi-vidsum/tree/ca03b147ddb4959229b510bde8eacc55933088af)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tohoku-nlp/multi-vidsum/tree/ca03b147ddb4959229b510bde8eacc55933088af)
- **Mirrors:** Legacy author redirect repository: https://github.com/keitokudo/Multi-VidSum
- **Preprocessing:** Frames every 0.5 seconds with CLIP image features; iterative baseline merges 20 MTM and PySceneDetect segments, removes segments longer than 75% of the video and refines four times
- **Features:** CLIP frame features, caption text and multiple valid frame candidates per caption; joint experiment configurations use N=4 pairs
- **Checksums:** Pinned download.tar.gz LFS pointer declares SHA-256 56c279b2f6a5a32d50c86df85c52ab755d77e8e40f9c68a7434ec8a034872196 and size 33,838,742,254 bytes; archive body was not downloaded or independently hashed
- **Leakage risks:** Validation subsets are randomly constructed from available data; pseudo-pretraining uses MS COCO and Visual Storytelling, whose image/source overlap was not audited
- **Limitations:** ActivityNet's original test references are unavailable, so 439 validation videos become the re-captioned test. The dataset card's Apache-2.0 declaration does not override underlying ActivityNet media rights; code/evaluator licensing, split hashes and independent execution remain unresolved.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-19
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://aclanthology.org/2023.emnlp-main.457.pdf) · [source 2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tohoku-nlp/multi-vidsum/tree/ca03b147ddb4959229b510bde8eacc55933088af) · [source 3](https://github.com/cl-tohoku/Multi-VidSum/tree/23a053970824926c2ae421ab9d5956ce133348b7) · [source 4](https://github.com/cl-tohoku/Multi-VidSum-Eval/tree/d4aa2fd4f1b88b65a14f2c66676fe1529572772a)

<a id="ovp"></a>

## OVP / VSUMM Open Video subset

- **Role:** adjacent
- **Task:** Static keyframe summarization; auxiliary training for later temporal methods
- **Domain:** Open Video documentaries
- **Videos:** 50
- **Duration:** Published range 1–4 minutes; author README approximately 75 minutes total
- **Annotations:** Static user-selected keyframes
- **Annotators:** 5 summaries per video
- **Granularity:** Selected still frames
- **Summary format:** Static keyframe set
- **Split:** No canonical split; later LSTM work uses all 50 as auxiliary training data
- **Metrics:** CUS / CUSA / CUSE; Content-matched keyframe precision, recall and F1 in later seqDPP protocol
- **License:** Not reported
- **Availability:** Author README links dataset, user-summary and evaluation archives; archive bytes not fetched in this run
- **Official url:** [official url](https://github.com/sandraavila/vsumm)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://www.dropbox.com/s/g0e64b4qfnuual1/database.zip?dl=1)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://www.dropbox.com/s/ilt1jpclzs2o18v/UserSummary.zip?dl=1)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** Native MPEG-1, 30 fps, 352x240; oracle keyframe-to-score conversions are method-derived labels
- **Features:** seqDPP author Fisher/saliency/context bundle; later GoogLeNet derivatives advertised, current download not verified
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** Derived oracle labels introduce human supervision; avoid treating auxiliary label transfer as unsupervised training
- **Limitations:** Content-matched still-frame metrics are not temporal-overlap F1; no dense native importance curve
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://github.com/sandraavila/vsumm) · [source 2](https://ic.unicamp.br/~sandra/pdf/papers/avila_PRL11.pdf) · [source 3](https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/zhang-eccv2016-lstm-summ-supp.pdf)

<a id="qfvs"></a>

## QFVS (Sharghi et al., CVPR 2017)

- **Role:** annotation-layer
- **Task:** Query-focused extractive video summarization
- **Domain:** Four UT Egocentric videos
- **Videos:** 4
- **Duration:** Same UTE recordings, approximately 3–5 hours/video
- **Annotations:** 48 concept tags; 46 queries per video; three user summaries per query-video pair; 5-second shot concept vectors
- **Annotators:** 3 workers per shot for concept tags (union); 3 student summary annotators
- **Granularity:** 5-second shots
- **Summary format:** Query-specific shot sets; unconstrained and 10/20-shot budgeted references
- **Split:** 4 rounds: 2 videos train, 1 validation, 1 test
- **Metrics:** Concept-IoU maximum-weight bipartite matching precision/recall/F1
- **License:** Not reported
- **Availability:** Paper and UTE source available; original QFVS project endpoint failed to fetch in this audit; current annotation download not independently verified
- **Official url:** [official url](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content_cvpr_2017/html/Sharghi_Query-Focused_Video_Summarization_CVPR_2017_paper.html)
- **Download url:** Not independently verified
- **Annotation url:** Not independently verified
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** Five sampled frames/shot during tagging; native concept metric uses semantic tags, not temporal overlap
- **Features:** Paper uses SentiBank-derived frame descriptors plus context; released tensor availability not independently verified
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** Concept tags are evaluation annotations; reuse during model optimization changes supervision. UTE/VideoSET share media.
- **Limitations:** 46 queries per video, not 46 unique videos; 48 is concept-vocabulary size. Query summaries are distinct from native UTE annotations.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.04960) · [source 2](https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/egocentric_data/UT_Egocentric_Dataset.html)

<a id="summe"></a>

## SumMe

- **Role:** core
- **Task:** Generic extractive video summarization
- **Domain:** User videos: holidays, events, sports
- **Videos:** 25
- **Duration:** Approximately 1–6 minutes/video
- **Annotations:** User-selected temporal intervals; human summary duration 5–15% of source
- **Annotators:** 15–18 per video
- **Granularity:** Temporal intervals mapped to original frames
- **Summary format:** Keyshot skim / binary temporal mask
- **Split:** No original canonical learning split; later random 80/20 canonical, augmented, and transfer protocols
- **Metrics:** Temporal-overlap F1 (original mean-user; later max-user)
- **License:** Not independently verified; repository MIT license must not be applied to source videos
- **Availability:** Institutional archive cited; full archive download and integrity not verified in this run
- **Official url:** [official url](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-319-10584-0_33)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://data.vision.ee.ethz.ch/cvl/SumMe/SumMe.zip)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://data.vision.ee.ethz.ch/cvl/SumMe/SumMe.zip)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** Later pipelines: 2 fps, original-frame index mapping, KTS, usually 15% budget. These are method conventions, not native annotations.
- **Features:** Later paper-author packages: GoogLeNet pool5 HDF5 (2 fps, 1024-D) and MSVA I3D RGB/flow; original dataset release has no deep tensors. See docs/03-datasets.md. ResNet-101 and VideoMAE ready-made tensors not independently verified.
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** Small corpus; external feature pretraining contamination unknown; do not use human-derived HDF5 fields for unsupervised checkpoint selection
- **Limitations:** Mean-user and max-user F1 are incompatible; source durations and checksums were not remeasured
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-319-10584-0_33) · [source 2](https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/zhang-eccv2016-lstm-summ.pdf) · [source 3](https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/zhang-eccv2016-lstm-summ-supp.pdf) · [source 4](https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM)

## SummScreen3D

- **Role:** core

- **Annotations:** Video/audio, transcripts, captions and multiple source recaps; 1.53 summaries/episode on average

- **Official url:** [official url](https://github.com/ppapalampidi/long_video_summarization)

- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://github.com/ppapalampidi/long_video_summarization)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** Shot detection and closed-caption/transcript alignment; keep all references of one episode in its assigned split
- **Features:** Paper describes multimodal extraction; ready-made tensor availability not independently verified
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** Shares episodes and text with SummScreen; multiple references must not create episode leakage; model pretraining contamination unknown

<a id="trinity"></a>

## TRINITY

- **Role:** core
- **Task:** Multi-perspective Event, Emotion and Nature video highlight detection
- **Domain:** Pooled open-web and personal-video sources from ten public datasets; Event reuses Mr. HiSum
- **Videos:** Paper reports Event 27,845, Emotion 16,257 and Nature 15,540. Pinned manifests contain 31,892 Event video_* keys, 16,257 Emotion clip/window keys and 15,540 Nature keys; only Nature marks 3,621 training keys with an _aug suffix.
- **Duration:** Aggregate source duration and range not reported; paper mean peak durations are 9.90 seconds Event, 4.87 seconds Emotion and 10.34 seconds Nature
- **Annotations:** Event replay-frequency targets; Emotion binary stable non-neutral facial-expression windows confirmed with Qwen2-VL-7B; Nature continuous scenic/aesthetic targets from YOLOv8n, CLIP prompts and Everypixel
- **Annotators:** Primarily behavioral/automatic labels, not full human summaries. Paper audits Emotion with three annotators on 50 segments and Nature with three annotators on 50 videos.
- **Granularity:** Model uses fixed 5-second segments. Event/Nature releases contain 1-fps features aggregated into 5-second means; Emotion is released as 5-second windows.
- **Summary format:** Three perspective-specific temporal saliency sequences; no decoded keyshot skim
- **Split:** Pinned manifests: Event 27,892/2,000/2,000 train/validation/test keys; Emotion 11,352/1,615/3,290; Nature 12,763/1,266/1,511. README and paper counts conflict with these files. Nature includes 3,621 train-only _aug keys; effective source-video counts are not established.
- **Metrics:** per-video mAP at top 15%; per-video mAP at top 50%; cross-perspective overlap
- **License:** Hugging Face card declares CC-BY-4.0 for the derived release; code is MIT; underlying source-video rights remain with original datasets and owners
- **Availability:** Pinned public Hugging Face release provides extracted features, labels and split manifests, not raw media; large archives were not downloaded
- **Official url:** [official url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanilladucky/TRINITY/tree/eb23873d1eb44fc8d600038fadfa39e7c5bb090f)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanilladucky/TRINITY/tree/eb23873d1eb44fc8d600038fadfa39e7c5bb090f)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanilladucky/TRINITY/tree/eb23873d1eb44fc8d600038fadfa39e7c5bb090f)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** Frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 features. Event and Nature loaders truncate incomplete 5-second tails; Emotion windows are already pooled. Nature training includes explicit augmented keys.
- **Features:** 512-dimensional CLIP arrays. Event uses NPZ data float32 plus float64 GT; Emotion uses NPZ features float16 plus labels/timing metadata; Nature uses NPZ features float16 plus JSON aesthetic scores.
- **Checksums:** Auditor-computed SHA-256 for pinned split bodies: Emotion 010db3932d226c2f993a3c6f8208fcc1f2bad98342409c32ea8800f10105ae43; Event 5c571d1d9f00b33662d631d85a62468dfb7599b096dc640d67873a2a0ba93f63; Nature b15283daa03cb99f771decfa4974df7c101c97edbcce3e5ed2436ec488d8fe67. Feature archives were not hashed.
- **Leakage risks:** Paper says Mr. HiSum test videos are removed from pretraining, but the Event manifest/effective-count conflict remains. Cross-source deduplication across ten pools is unverified; automated labels inherit pretrained-model and proprietary-service bias.
- **Limitations:** Paper, README and release counts disagree; video, clip and augmented-key terminology is inconsistent. The effective Event split requires unavailable archive-level checking. Nature depends on a proprietary scorer, and raw video is not released.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-19
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.29577v1) · [source 2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanilladucky/TRINITY/tree/eb23873d1eb44fc8d600038fadfa39e7c5bb090f) · [source 3](https://github.com/vanilladucky/TRINITY/tree/dc70fdecb98de5888f71159f6ac1ea223103b9bf)

<a id="tvsum"></a>

## TVSum / TVSum50

- **Role:** core
- **Task:** Generic extractive video summarization
- **Domain:** 10 web-video event categories
- **Videos:** 50
- **Duration:** Approximately 2–10 minutes/video
- **Annotations:** 1–5 importance rating for every 2-second unit; 1000 video-level responses
- **Annotators:** 20 per video
- **Granularity:** Uniform 2-second annotation units
- **Summary format:** Importance scores; reference keyshots require decoding
- **Split:** No original canonical learning split; later random 80/20 and five-split conventions
- **Metrics:** Temporal-overlap F1, mean across users; Kendall tau / Spearman rho for score ranking (later diagnostic)
- **License:** Video source release identifies Creative Commons CC-BY 3.0; code and derived features need their own license checks
- **Availability:** Official README advertises hosted videos and URLs; author download directory is canonical. Full archive not downloaded.
- **Official url:** [official url](https://github.com/yalesong/tvsum)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://people.csail.mit.edu/yalesong/tvsum/)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://people.csail.mit.edu/yalesong/tvsum/tvsum50_ver_1_1.tgz)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** Original annotation uses 2-second units; later KTS reference construction changes the protocol
- **Features:** Later paper-author packages: GoogLeNet pool5 HDF5 (2 fps, 1024-D) and MSVA I3D RGB/flow; original dataset release has no deep tensors. See docs/03-datasets.md. ResNet-101 and VideoMAE ready-made tensors not independently verified.
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** Titles were visible during annotation; test reference scores must not tune models; public web-video contamination unknown
- **Limitations:** Do not equate raw ratings with binary user summaries or mix original units and shared-KTS references
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://github.com/yalesong/tvsum) · [source 2](https://people.csail.mit.edu/yalesong/publications/SongVSJ2015CVPR.pdf) · [source 3](https://github.com/yalesong/tvsum/blob/master/matlab/script_evaluate_result.m)

<a id="videoxum"></a>

## VideoXum

- **Role:** core
- **Task:** Cross-modal visual and textual video summarization
- **Domain:** ActivityNet-Captions activity videos
- **Videos:** 14001
- **Duration:** Paper: 10–755 seconds; mean 124.2 seconds
- **Annotations:** 10 visual summary masks per video; event-caption text; 140010 visual/text pairs
- **Annotators:** 10 visual summaries per video; text references are shared caption lists, not ten independent texts
- **Granularity:** Uniform 1-fps visual positions; temporal event captions
- **Summary format:** Binary visual mask plus textual summary
- **Split:** 8000 train / 2001 validation / 4000 test
- **Metrics:** F1-Avg; F1-Max; Kendall tau; Spearman rho; BLEU-4; METEOR; ROUGE-L; CIDEr; VT-CLIPScore
- **License:** Official Hugging Face dataset card: Apache-2.0; this does not relicense underlying ActivityNet/YouTube videos
- **Availability:** Official Hugging Face annotations and features advertised; raw video bytes not bundled
- **Official url:** [official url](https://videoxum.github.io/)
- **Download url:** [download url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/jylins/videoxum/tree/main)
- **Annotation url:** [annotation url](https://huggingface.co/datasets/jylins/videoxum)
- **Mirrors:** Not reported
- **Preprocessing:** 1 fps; author evaluator commit 11bd4fe3 uses threshold at floor(0.15*N) with >=, selecting floor(0.15*N)+1 unique positions and possibly more ties. No KTS/knapsack. Correlation compares scores with mean-annotator ratings, not per-user correlation then averaging.
- **Features:** Official BLIP and fine-tuned VT-CLIP ViT-B/16 archives; VT-CLIP is not generic frozen CLIP
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
- **Leakage risks:** ActivityNet overlap and upstream video-language pretraining contamination unknown; keep dataset partitions when fine-tuning VT-CLIP
- **Limitations:** Cross-modal, visual-only and textual metrics answer different questions; native frame selection differs from SumMe/TVSum
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.12060) · [source 2](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum) · [source 3](https://huggingface.co/datasets/jylins/videoxum) · [source 4](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/utils.py#L275) · [source 5](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/eval_v2vt_sum.py#L61)

## YouTube / VSUMM web-video corpus

- **Role:** adjacent
- **Task:** Static keyframe summarization; auxiliary training for later temporal methods

- **Annotations:** Static user-selected keyframes
- **Annotators:** 5 summaries per video
- **Granularity:** Selected still frames
- **Summary format:** Static keyframe set
- **Split:** Original release 50 videos; seqDPP/LSTM use a 39-video non-cartoon subset
- **Metrics:** CUS / CUSA / CUSE; Content-matched keyframe precision, recall and F1 in later seqDPP protocol

- **Features:** seqDPP Fisher/saliency/context bundle for 39-video subset; later GoogLeNet derivatives advertised but not downloaded
- **Checksums:** Not independently verified
